primary_metric: GitHub stargazers_count at archived retrieval timestamp
robustness_metric: PyPI daily downloads over latest available contiguous 90 complete days; mirrors excluded; never change primary sample
scope_note: Finite search-defined discovery universe, not an exhaustive census of all Python frameworks. Eligibility provenance must be archived before any framework execution.
eligibility: Python agent/RAG framework with official-documentation-linked runnable RAG example. Official parallel/ensemble primitive is a later recipe-selection requirement, NOT a candidate eligibility criterion. Exclude lists, courses, standalone model implementations, and personal demos. Application builders are not excluded merely because they have a UI. Do not exclude based on expected class.
dedup: same canonical repository once; projects in same ecosystem remain separate and ecosystem is annotated
recipe_rule: step-1: same official example contains retrieval plus parallel/ensemble primitive detected by AST/keyword scan; otherwise step-2 official RAG branch body combined with official parallel primitive, with both provenance pointers and unchanged prompt/defaults
selection_gate: Do not select pilot until complete candidate eligibility registry and star snapshots are frozen
classification_gate: User clarified two-pass measurement; require 4/4 controls in each of both exact templates before any framework execution
